age.evidence: inferred: Aged-matched female Balb/c mice (6-12 weeks old) were used for orthotopic and experimental liver metastasis models.

cell_line.evidence: The KPC cell line was isolated from a PDAC tumor and was a gift from the Tuveson Laboratory (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory, United States).
The 4T1 cell line was a kind gift from Fred Miller (Wayne State University).

The b.End5 cell line, herein referred to as the tumor endothelial cells (TEC), derived from brain endothelioma of BALB/c mouse, was a gift from the depositor (#96091930, Culture Collections UK) to the University of Copenhagen.
BALB-5023, derived from BALB/c mouse primary brain microvascular endothelial cells, herein referred to as a normal endothelial cell (NEC), was purchased from Cell Biologics (Cat. BALB-5023).

cell_type.evidence: The aim of the project was to compare the secretomes of normal endothelial cells (NECs) and tumor endothelial cells (TECs).
